data.الأزرار داخل mco-record__actions تأخذ مق: Buttons inside mco-record__actions take 36px and 7px corners automatically: view details at the start of the line, edit and delete at its end.
data.الحقائق تتوزع بالتساوي ويفصلها خط، وعلى: Facts spread equally with dividers between them, and stack on mobile.
data.الشريط العمودي مرسوم من الثيم (::before): The vertical bar is drawn by the theme (::before), so it needs no element.
data.الغرض يظهر بسطرين ثم «عرض المزيد»؛ جرّب: The purpose shows two lines, then “Show more”; try clicking it in the preview.
data.الفرق عن MCO_AddMore: هذي تشغل مساحة الم: The difference from MCO_AddMore: this fills the whole content area; AddMore is a standalone bar.
data.الفرق عن MCO_Stepper (الأسهم): هذا أخف و: The difference from MCO_Stepper (arrows): this is lighter and suits in-page forms. On mobile, titles of steps other than the current one hide.
data.بطاقة نشاط في شبكة: مربع التاريخ مع التص: An activity card in a grid: the date tile with the main category, then a divider, then the subcategory and the linked goal.
data.تُعرض البطاقات في شبكة تحت MCO_CardHeade: Cards show in a grid under MCO_CardHeader: a Container with display grid, three columns on desktop and one on mobile.
data.حقول خاصة قبل Fields: MCO_InfoField بـ T: Special fields before Fields: MCO_InfoField with Type = "country" or "chip"
data.خطوات بدوائر مرقّمة وخطوط بينها، تحت كل: Steps as numbered circles joined by lines, each with “Step X of N” and its title. Three states: not started, in progress, completed. Used inside the navbar (Type = stepper) or above a long form.
data.دائرة 42px: صورة الشخص بحد خفيف، أو أيقو: A 42px circle: the person’s photo with a light border, a person icon on bg-brand-soft when there’s no photo, or an add-person button.
data.داخل MCO_Navbar بـ Type = \"stepper\": ض: Inside MCO_Navbar with Type = "stepper": put the Block in the Steps Placeholder with ExtraClass = "mco-nav__steps" to get the 68px band under the title.
data.داخل رأس صفحة التفاصيل (MCO_DetailHeader: Inside the details page header (MCO_DetailHeader), items are separated by a divider automatically.
data.سجل للقراءة بحقول MCO_InfoField متساوية: A read-only record with equal-width MCO_InfoField fields and a gradient border, and below a divider the view details button at the start and edit/delete at the end. The visit and reception types add the country, classification and purpose with “Show more”.
data.شريط أدوات متدرّج، ثم مسار التنقل وعنوان: A gradient toolbar, then the breadcrumbs, page title, back button and main action on a gradient background with soft ripples. Four types: default, tabs, simple and stepper.
data.شكل section من الإطار «Frame 1820548552»: The section style comes from the frame “Frame 1820548552” (74:5204), and the card style from the “Empty state” component (719:7652).
data.عنوان رمادي 16px وقيمة عريضة 20px بلون t: A grey 16px label and a bold 20px text-brand value. Types: text, a country with its flag, or a classification as a chip. It’s the field inside the record card.
data.عنوان قسم 20px بلون text-brand يسبقه شري: A 20px text-brand section title preceded by a 4×24 vertical bar, with an optional counter pill.
data.محدّث من Figma (navbar 2:20663): الشريط: Updated from Figma (navbar 2:20663): the top strip is a gradient from action-primary-default to bg-navbar, and the background below it a gradient from bg-brand-soft to bg-surface with soft circular ripples, all from the theme with no images.
data.محدّث من Figma («#TableField /)» 673:724: Updated from Figma (“#TableField /)” 673:7244): a 1.5px gradient border from border-brand-subtle to border-focus, and a border-brand-subtle divider above the buttons.
data.مربع 64px يعرض التاريخ كتقويم: شريط الشه: A 64px tile showing the date like a calendar: an icon-brand-strong month strip, then the bold 22px day, then the year.
data.مسار التنقل 14px بلون text-tertiary، وزر: Breadcrumbs are 14px text-tertiary, and the back button sits on bg-subtle without a border.
data.معلومة قصيرة بأيقونة في دائرة 40px، وعنو: A short fact with an icon in a 40px circle, a 13px label and a bold 15px value. Three tones: brand, success, or a status badge instead of the value.
data.ملف مرفق: أيقونة نوعه واسمه وتاريخ الرفع: An attached file: its type icon, name, upload date and size, view and download buttons at the end of the line, and an optional notes line below.
data.نص الغرض (زيارة أو استقبال)، بدون قيمة =: Purpose text (visit or reception); empty = no purpose section
data.نص بديل للصورة أو لقارئ الشاشة: Alternative text for the image or screen readers
data.نوع «tow actions»: Container بكلاس mco-a: The “tow actions” type: a Container with class mco-addbanner__actions holding "btn" (Return with notes, back-square) then "btn btn-primary" (Accept request, verify), with ShowButton = False
data.هو مؤشر الخطوات المعتمد في الدليل (حلّ م: This is the guide's stepper (it replaces the MCO_Stepper arrow stepper). On mobile, titles of steps other than the current one hide; for long forms on mobile, MCO_WizardProgress also works.
data.أزرار btn (اختياري)، أو \"btn mco-dialog: btn buttons (optional), or "btn mco-dialog__cta" in the small side-button layout
data.أول ما يظهر في صفحة الخدمة: كبسولة تصنيف: The top of a service page: a service-category pill, the service name at 32px, its description, and a “Ready to start?” card with the start button at the end of the line (left in Arabic). Gradient background with faint rings on the card side.
data.البطاقة تمدّ ارتفاعها لتساوي جارتها في ا: Cards stretch to match their neighbour in the grid, and the responsible party stays pinned to the bottom (margin-top: auto).
data.الحلقات والخلفية المتدرّجة مرسومة من الث: The rings and gradient background are drawn by the theme (::before), so no image is needed.
data.الخط المتلاشي مرسوم من الثيم (::after عل: The fading line is drawn by the theme (::after on the header), so no element is needed.
data.الخط الواصل بين الدوائر مرسوم من الثيم،: The connector between the circles is drawn by the theme, so don’t add an element between them.
data.الصغير بزر جانبي (Size = \"small\" · Lay: Small with a side button (Size = "small" · Layout = "left", Figma 1021:8123): a 4px colour bar at the start of the line and a status-coloured title. Its action is a Button with class "btn mco-dialog__cta", filled with the status colour automatically, at the end of the line (left in Arabic). See it in “Service page template”.
data.بطاقة مرحلة من مراحل الخدمة: أيقونة في م: A card for one service phase: an icon in a gradient tile, a “Phase 1 · Steps 1–3” line, the phase name, then the steps numbered in connected circles, and the responsible party at the bottom.
data.بين أقسام المحتوى 24px، والمحتوى بعرض أق: Content sections are 24px apart, centred with a max width of 1304px.
data.تحت 900px تنزل البطاقة تحت النص ويأخذ ال: Below 900px the card drops under the text and the button takes the full width.
data.ترتيب العناصر في الشجرة هو ترتيب القراءة: The tree order is the reading order: content first, then the card, so the card lands at the end of the line (left in Arabic, right in English) without any dir.
data.رقم أول خطوة (4 في المرحلة الثانية مثلاً: Number of the first step (e.g. 4 in the second phase)
data.قالب جاهز لصفحة بداية أي خدمة: شريط التن: A ready-made landing screen for any service: the navbar with the request name, an optional notice, the service hero, then the service steps by phase. “Start service” goes to the first wizard step.
data.قسم «خطوات الخدمة»: عنوان 24px مع كبسولة: The “Service steps” section: a 24px heading with a phase-count pill and a line fading to the end, above a grid of phase cards (two columns on desktop, one on mobile).
data.مثل: edit للإعداد، verify للاعتماد: e.g. edit for preparation, verify for approval
data.هذا قالب شاشة وليس Block: انسخه كبداية ل: This is a screen template, not a Block: copy it as the starting point for any new service and change the texts and phases.
data.وصف الخدمة في سطرين أو ثلاثة: Service description in two or three lines
data.قالب جاهز لصفحة بداية أي خدمة: شريط التن: A ready-made landing screen for any service: the navbar with the request name, the service hero, then the service steps by phase. “Start service” goes to the first wizard step.
data.الصغير بزر جانبي (Size = \"small\" · Lay: Small with a side button (Size = "small" · Layout = "left", Figma 1021:8123): a 4px colour bar at the start of the line and a status-coloured title. Its action is a Button with class "btn mco-dialog__cta", filled with the status colour automatically, at the end of the line (left in Arabic).
